name: XCC_CONTROL_BUDGETS_GT
description: This temporary table contains data that is used to create control budgets in bulk.

columns.name: CONTROL_BUDGET_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the control budget.

columns.name: NAME
columns.description: Unique identifier of the control budget.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description of the control budget.

columns.name: START_PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Period when the control budget starts being effective.

columns.name: END_PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Period when the control budget stops being effective.

columns.name: CALENDAR_ID
columns.description: Calendar identifier used for the control budget.

columns.name: SOURCE_BUDGET_SYSTEM_CODE
columns.description: Source budget type code of the control budget.

columns.name: FUNDS_RELEASE_TIMEFRAME
columns.description: Determines when the funds are made available for a particular period. Possible values are RELEASE_IMMEDIATELY and RELEASE_UPON_OPEN.

columns.name: CONTROL_LEVEL_CODE
columns.description: Control level code to determine funds available.

columns.name: TOLERANCE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Fixed amount used as tolerance.

columns.name: TOLERANCE_PERCENT
columns.description: Percentage of the budget amount that is used as tolerance.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency assigned to the control budget.

columns.name: UOM_CODE
columns.description: Unit of measure assigned to the control budget.

columns.name: DEFAULT_RATE_TYPE
columns.description: Default rate type assigned to the control budget.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Primary ledger identifier defined in the GL and enabled for budgetary control.

columns.name: PROJECT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the accounting project. The default value is -98.

columns.name: BUDGET_CHART_OF_ACCOUNTS_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the key flexfield structure that is used to define columns for control budget accounts.

columns.name: BUDGET_MANAGER_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the budget manager responsible for the control budget.

columns.name: BALANCE_INCREASES_ALLOWED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether increases are allowed as adjustments to the initial loaded amounts for the budget account combination of the control budget. The default value is Y.

columns.name: BALANCE_DECREASES_ALLOWED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether decreases are allowed as adjustments to the initial loaded amounts for the budget account combination of the control budget. The default value is Y.

columns.name: NEGATIVE_BALANCES_ALLOWED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the funds available balance can assume a negative value when adjusted to the initial loaded amounts for budget account combination of the control budget. The default value is N.

columns.name: PJC_CONTRACT_ID
columns.description: Unique project accounting contract identifier for the award associated with the budget amount. The default value is -98.

columns.name: ALLOW_OVERRIDES_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if overrides are allowed for this control budget.

columns.name: NO_OVERRIDES_NOTIFY_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the budget manager must be notified when no overrides are available.

columns.name: OVERRIDES_TAKEN_NOTIFY_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the budget manager must be notified when an override is taken.

columns.name: MAXIMUM_OVERRIDE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Maximum override amount allowed for this control budget. Amount is in the budget currency.

columns.name: INTERNAL_BUDGET_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Order of segments in the budget chart of accounts structure for project based control budgets. For example, PARF indicates a segment order of Project, Award, Top Resource, and Funding Source.

columns.name: FV_DISTRIBUTE_BUDGET_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the Federal budget is enabled for budget distribution. Possible vallues are Y and N.

columns.name: FV_CONSUME_BUDGET_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the Federal budget is enabled for consumption. Possible values are Y and N.

columns.name: MASTER_CONTROL_BUDGET_NAME
columns.description: Detail control budget name of the summary control budget.

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: The processing status of the control budget.

columns.name: IMPORT_DATA_SET_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier to call the control budget import process.
